statement: Every finite subgroup of the full pure three-cusp loop-outer group, and hence of GT0, injects by its 2-adic multiplier into C2. Every finite subgroup of the full type-(0,3) loop-outer group injects by puncture permutation and 2-adic multiplier into S3 times C2. The proof establishes that a closed rank-two mod-p subgroup of the full free profinite group containing conjugates of all three full cusp Zp subgroups is the entire group.

notes: The finite-cover argument concerns the actual closed fixed subgroup and supplies the missing third-cusp information beyond its maximal pro-p quotient. The canonical normalization of the pure loop-outer group is proved by exact inner conjugators and abelian coordinates. The full pure group is not silently replaced by GT0. D34 proves all prime signs globally minus one; conjugacy of the surviving involutions remains unresolved; the abstract finite-group injection is unconditional.
